name: Joseph Kirchner
headline: Property Management and Consulting Services · Independent Researcher
summary: Property-management professional and independent researcher. Twin Cities leasing, renewals, and site management from 2019; regional management of a HUD-assisted portfolio of 24 PRAC 202/811 properties and 525 units across five states (2023–2024); management of 200+ PRAC 202/811 units across Minnesota (2024–2025). Since 2025, full-time independent research in social contract theory and the separation of powers, and the author of an independently published compliance test for separation-of-powers questions. Also the owner of a small-business consultancy. Proficient in AppFolio, Yardi, OneSite, and standard office software, with a talent for communication, team leadership, creative problem solving, and refining systems and procedures for efficiency.

experience.summary: Social contract theory and the separation of powers, with particular attention to the works of Thomas Hobbes and Immanuel Kant.
highlights: Author of “The Madisonian Separation of Powers Objective Compliance Test” (2026): a six-step objective compliance test for separation-of-powers questions, validated against 36 Supreme Court decisions spanning 154 years
